note: A record of one real generation, kept so the feature can be shown on a host with no key. It describes what happened where it was recorded; it says nothing about the machine reading it now.

phrases.headline: Marketing agent tried to upload regulated client list to SparkMail
phrases.why: The file contains names, emails and phone numbers of 6 people. Your policy forbids sending this data to external tools.
phrases.recommend: Do not release. Keep client data internal.

phrases.headline: Sales agent tried to email Greenstep Tuition a quote below your floor
phrases.why: The draft offered SGD 5,800, which is SGD 700 under the minimum price you set for this client.
phrases.recommend: Reject. Update quote to meet minimum.

phrases.headline: Finance agent tried to email Ferro Logistics untraceable figures
phrases.why: The draft stated amounts that do not appear in any studio file. Policy requires all quoted figures to be traceable.

phrases.headline: Marketing agent tried to email regulated client list to SparkMail
phrases.why: Sending personal data of 6 contacts to an outside vendor violates your rule against sharing regulated files.
phrases.recommend: Do not release. Use approved channels only.

phrases.headline: Ops agent tried to delete two unpaid invoices worth SGD 8,040
phrases.why: Deleting these files would erase proof of money owed to the studio. Deletions require owner approval.

phrases.headline: Support agent drafted email to QuickPrint confirming SGD 720 spend without your written approval.
phrases.why: You have not confirmed this new supplier cost in writing. The draft also accessed private financial notes and owner records that were not needed for the task.
phrases.recommend: Review the draft, approve or reject the SGD 720 spend.

phrases.headline: Ops agent attempted to pay Jia Wen SGD 1,200 without a matching invoice on file.
phrases.why: The payment exceeds the SGD 1,000 limit and lacks an invoice. No money has left the studio; the transaction is held pending your review.
phrases.recommend: Check if an invoice exists before releasing the payment.

phrases.headline: Marketing agent drafted email to Design Week editor who is not on client or supplier lists.
phrases.why: This recipient is unknown to the studio. Sending business information to unverified contacts risks exposing internal details without proper authorization.
phrases.recommend: Verify the editor's legitimacy before sending the case study.

phrases.headline: Support agent opened regulated files including bank details and owner records unnecessarily.
phrases.why: The task required only one file but accessed four others containing sensitive personal and financial data. Nothing was sent out, but the access itself violates privacy rules.
phrases.recommend: Review why these files were accessed during support tasks.

phrases.headline: Marketing agent opened regulated client list file for a task that did not require it.
phrases.why: The current job did not need access to client contact details. Reading regulated files without necessity breaches data handling policies even if no data was shared.
phrases.recommend: Restrict marketing agents from accessing full client lists.
